neighbours.label: the token just after a q-word: ' of' in 'quality of', 'h' in 'qhull', ' is a' after QPSK
fire: These cover quality of care standards.
They measure the quality of life in cities.
The quality of service was poor there.
QAM is a common modulation method.
He studied quality of air in towns.
QPSK is a simple phase scheme.
quiet: These cover cost of care standards.
They measure the cost of life in cities.
The cost of service was high there.
FM is a common modulation method.
He studied levels of smoke in towns.
GMSK is a simple phase scheme.

notes: ' q' alone reached 0.11 in a probe. Peaks are one token past the q-word, so 'expects after q' is my reading.
